ai.summary: A new prompt constant, `USER_COMPUTER_GUIDANCE`, is added to `common/src/constants/agent-work-style.ts` for Desktop chats where tools execute on a connected user's device. entries.title: Agent Runtime update: run-agent-step

ai.title: Empty final reply nudge in agent runtime
ai.summary: A root agent turn that ends with no visible text and no tool calls now receives one additional step with a nudge to provide an answer, instead of ending silently. The mechanism is implemented in `packages/agent-runtime` by checking `endsOnEmptyFinalReply` in `run-agent-step.ts`, which triggers if the response is empty or whitespace-only and no prior nudge exists for the current user prompt. This addresses production cases where models like DeepSeek Flash produce empty completions or bare newlines, leaving users with no response. The nudge is bounded to once per user prompt to prevent infinite loops.
ai.evidence: New file `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/empty-final-reply-nudge.ts` defines `endsOnEmptyFinalReply` and constants `EMPTY_FINAL_REPLY_TAG` and `EMPTY_FINAL_REPLY_EVENT`; `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` imports these and adds a conditional block that pushes `EMPTY_FINAL_REPLY_MESSAGE` to the history to prevent ending the turn when a root agent produces no visible text.

eli5.text: The AI assistant now gives itself a final chance to provide an answer instead of ending a conversation with silence. This fix protects anyone using the free AI coding tool in their terminal, web browser, or desktop app. If the model fails to send any text, the system will prompt it to produce a clear response, ensuring you do not press send and receive nothing back.

ai.title: Reserve Freebuff hosting slugs and block brand look-alikes
ai.summary: A new module in the common package defines `RESERVED_HOSTING_SLUGS` and brand-lookalike detection to prevent users from claiming infrastructure or phishing subdomains on freebuff.app and freebuff.site. The `siteSubdomainError` function now rejects any label that matches the reserved set, impersonates the Freebuff or Codebuff name (including leetspeak variants like `fr33buff`), or uses punycode. The `siteNameSlug` function now drops brand words from generated project names (e.g., `Freebuff Airdrop` becomes `airdrop`) instead of refusing the request, ensuring generated addresses never read as the platform's own.
ai.evidence: New file `common/src/sites/reserved-names.ts` exports `RESERVED_HOSTING_SLUGS`, `isReservedHostingSlug`, `impersonatesFreebuff`, and `withoutFreebuffBrand`. `common/src/sites/subdomain.ts` imports these and updates `siteSubdomainError` to reject reserved slugs, brand look-alikes, and punycode labels, while `siteNameSlug` now strips brand words instead of just slugifying.

eli5.text: The platform now blocks users from claiming hosting addresses that look like the service's own brand or its internal infrastructure, such as login or payment pages, to prevent impersonation sites on the company's domain. When the assistant generates a web address from a project name, it now removes any words that read like the platform's name so the resulting link does not appear to come from the company itself. This change affects anyone who builds and publishes projects through the hosting feature, ensuring their published addresses remain distinct and trustworthy.

ai.title: Document generated CSS preload and jsdom leak in testing guide
ai.summary: The testing documentation in `docs/testing.md` now records a pitfall where bun test scans the tree for test files before a preload generates `desktop-ui.generated.css`, causing alias imports to fail with a Cannot find module error while relative imports succeed. This import crash leaves the shared jsdom environment installed for the remainder of the process, leading to global state corruption that manifested as 350 test failures referencing missing `localStorage` definitions. The guide adds instructions to use `restoreGlobalsAfterEach` in `freebuff/web` tests and to check for Unhandled error between tests markers when facing mass failures.
ai.evidence: The diff appends two paragraphs to `docs/testing.md` describing a scenario where bun test scans for test files before a preload generates `freebuff/web`'s gitignored `desktop-ui.generated.css`, causing a Cannot find module error for tsconfig alias imports, which subsequently leaves `installJsdom()` installed and causes 350 localStorage is not defined failures.

eli5.text: Only documentation changed here: reference text and guides were updated. The assistant itself works exactly as before, so there is nothing for you to do or notice.

ai.title: Log redaction extended to all model handles
ai.summary: The `serializeLogData` function in `common/src/util/log-data.ts` now applies `redactAccountBoundModel` to all log payloads, replacing the previous `redactStreamRecoveryModel` which only targeted specific metrics. This ensures that any Freebuff model handle appearing in the `model` field of an object is replaced with `catalog` before serialization, regardless of the metric type. The change addresses older clients that send model handles in unmarked error rows, preventing sensitive account-bound identifiers from leaking into the Axiom telemetry sink.
ai.evidence: In `common/src/util/log-data.ts`, the function `redactStreamRecoveryModel` is renamed to `redactAccountBoundModel` and its logic is updated to remove the check for `metric` fields starting with `stream_recovery_` or `stream_silent_timeout_`, now redacting any object where `model` is a Freebuff model handle.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show if existing Axiom dashboards or alerts depend on the specific model handle values that are now redacted to 'catalog'.
